notes: «رجل من أهل رقه يقال له أبو المضا» is one link: the text names him (rule 8), so the surface is the kunya alone.

«قال لي رجل» is an unnamed transmitter of the Imam's words to Abu al-Mada (occurrence 2 of رجل); the Imam «قال أبو عبد الله ع» is the last link (owner ruling 2). «قال قلت نعم» is Abu al-Mada's own speech, not a new link.
The first-person «أبي» is a relation link (occurrence 1); «أبي عبد الله» later in the saying is the Imam's tomb, not a link.
